strategies.name: Sequential All-Reduce with Fused Local Ops
strategies.desc: Eight sequential all_reduce calls with all local scaling/division operations fused between dispatches using vectorized tensor operations. Exactly 8 collective dispatches with minimal memory allocations by reusing buffers. Represents the baseline: straightforward translation of the dependency chain with maximum local-op fusion.

strategies.name: Pipelined All-Reduce with Overlapped Computation
strategies.desc: Split the 8 all_reduce stages into overlapping computation regions by dividing the tensor into chunks and launching the next all_reduce on already-processed chunks while computing local operations on others. Increases total dispatches (8+ collectives) but can hide computation latency behind communication if hardware supports asynchronous dispatch.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit potential multi-node topology by decomposing each of the 8 all_reduce operations into intra-node reduce-scatter + inter-node all_reduce + intra-node all_gather sequences. Increases dispatch count to 24 collectives but may reduce per-operation payload size and better utilize hierarchical network bandwidth on multi-node deployments.

strategies.name: Batched All-Reduce with Tensor Concatenation
strategies.desc: Pre-compute multiple intermediate buffers locally and batch multiple logical all_reduce operations into fewer physical dispatches by concatenating payloads. Reduces dispatch count (potentially 4-6 collectives) at the cost of larger per-dispatch payload and increased memory footprint for staging buffers, trading off memory for dispatch overhead.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Decomposition Chain
strategies.desc:
Replace each all_reduce with a reduce_scatter followed by local computation on the reduced shard, then all_gather to broadcast results. Doubles collective count to 16 dispatches but reduces per-collective payload by factor of W, potentially winning when network is bandwidth-bound rather than latency-bound at world_size=224.
